verdict_reason: The new continueFromAddressesToOverview() call needs a recorded reference number this spec never records, so the test throws at the CPH step.

todos.issue: The CPH step now calls animalsJourney.continueFromAddressesToOverview() (120), which ends in openCurrentOverview() -> currentReferenceNumber() (journey.ts:292-296), and that throws 'No notification has been started' when the journey context holds no reference. This spec never records one: its beforeEach is toNotificationDashboard() (journey.ts:140, records nothing) and it creates the notification itself via dashboard.btnCreateNewNotification.click() (23), keeping the reference in a local (29). Only createNotificationAtOrigin/recordReferenceNumberFromUrl record it. The replaced lines opened Overview from the page URL and did not depend on the context, so the test now fails at this step; the PR's E2E Tests check does not run @a11y, so it stays green.
todos.fix: Must: the initial-state a11y test reaches Overview after the addresses page without relying on an unrecorded reference, and passes when run. One way: have the spec record its notification through the journey (e.g. a public AnimalsJourney method that clicks Create new notification from the dashboard and records the reference, called in the Origin of import step), then keep continueFromAddressesToOverview(); run this spec with test:docker-compose before pushing.
